en_description: We are looking for a Software Engineer to engage in cutting-edge AI research and development at a certified venture originating from Hokkaido University. This position allows for full remote work and flexible hours. As a Software Engineer, you will be responsible for contract development of AI solutions, promoting standardization and efficiency of internal operations, and managing and operating internal services.

We are looking for a Numerical AI Engineer to join our cutting-edge AI technology development team. This position is fully remote and offers flexible working hours. As an AI development engineer for client projects in our AI research and development business, you will be responsible for the following tasks: collaborating with other engineers to develop algorithms and services using mathematical optimization methods, deep learning, and machine learning; identifying client challenges and exploring technical solutions; conducting technical research through international conferences and papers; data collection and customer data analysis; data visualization; and report writing.

We are seeking a System Development Group Manager for a cutting-edge AI research and development venture originating from Hokkaido University. This position is fully remote and offers full flexibility. As a manager of the group responsible for system development and standardization of internal technologies, you will primarily be responsible for acquiring, promoting, and managing development projects, while collaborating with the R&D department head, deputy head, and other group managers to strengthen the organizational structure. Your duties will include leading and managing a group of about five members, understanding client needs in collaboration with sales members, overseeing and managing multiple individual projects (approximately five) from a holistic perspective, guiding and developing group members (especially project leaders), and managing product, AI engine infrastructure, and platform development and operations as a project manager. You will also handle client negotiations and schedule management for all contracted projects. While coding is not expected, you should be able to review the deliverables developed by your team at a design level.

In the startup phase of the organization, you will have the discretion to move from strategic planning to execution as a Partner Sales representative. The company, ROSCA, is focused on providing maximum value by supporting the careers and recruitment of IT personnel. The main business, the Seamless Career Business, acts as a specialized agent for IT personnel, providing career support for junior to high-career levels, full-time employees, and contractors, as well as recruitment support for SaaS companies and SIers. The role involves matching and closing freelance engineers and projects with partner companies, controlling existing partner companies, developing new partners, and strategizing and executing for the PS team.

Join ROSCA Inc. as a Sales Administrator and transition from inexperienced to a professional in 'office work in the DX era.' You will have the opportunity to utilize AI and create systems. The salary ranges from 3.6 to 5 million yen annually. This is a full-time position based in Chiyoda, Tokyo, with some remote work available.
